Fairview Public Library – New Borrowing Policy

Starting November 1st, Fairview Public Library will implement a new borrowing policy for all patrons.

- Standard borrowing period extends from 2 weeks to 3 weeks for books
- Patrons may now borrow up to 15 items at a time, up from 10
- Overdue fines are eliminated for books; however, a $1 per day fee will still apply to overdue DVDs and equipment rentals

These changes are part of our effort to make library resources more accessible to the community. Patrons with existing overdue books as of November 1st will have those fines waived automatically.
passage2:
To: All Library Members
From: Fairview Public Library
Subject: Reminder: New Borrowing Policy Starts November 1st

Dear Member,

As a reminder, our new borrowing policy takes effect on November 1st. We encourage you to take advantage of the extended borrowing period and increased item limit.

If you currently have items checked out under the old policy, your due dates will remain as originally scheduled, but any new items borrowed on or after November 1st will follow the new 3-week period.

We have also updated our website's FAQ page with answers to common questions about the new policy. Please take a look if you have any questions.

Thank you for being a valued member of Fairview Public Library.

A: Yes, any overdue fines on books as of November 1st will be automatically removed from your account. This does not apply to DVDs or equipment rentals.

A: Yes, a $1 per day fee still applies to overdue DVDs and equipment.

Q: Do I need to do anything to receive the new 3-week borrowing period?
A: No action is needed. The new period will apply automatically to any items borrowed on or after November 1st.
